channel.title: Secure Media Tech Insights
channel.description: Cybersecurity, AI, event technology and smart venues — field notes from Dubai.

item.title: Choosing a Penetration Testing Partner in the UAE: Scope, Legality and the Questions That Expose a Checkbox Vendor
item.description: UAE entities face regulator-driven security testing expectations. A certified tester explains scoping rules, legal authorisation, and how to tell real offensive engineering from a report factory.
item.author: Zeeshan Haider

item.title: Projection Rigs Are Infrastructure: Lessons From Keeping 18 Installations Alive at EXPO 2020 Dubai
item.description: Six months, eighteen projection mapping installations, millions of visitors. What treating media servers like enterprise hosts taught us — and how to apply it to any venue.
item.author: Zeeshan Haider

item.title: Sovereign AI for Government Events: Why the UAE Should Never Ship Summit Data Offshore
item.description: Ministerial forums and national summits generate intelligence-grade content. Here is the architecture for AI transcription, summarisation and knowledge search that keeps every byte inside sovereign infrastructure.
item.author: Zeeshan Haider

item.title: Zero Trust for Live Events: Securing Badge Systems, Wi-Fi and Interactive Installations Under Crowd Pressure
item.description: Smart badges, delegate portals and interactive kiosks turn events into attack surfaces. A practical zero-trust blueprint for event CIOs and venue operators in the GCC.
item.author: Zeeshan Haider
